{{Quote|If we leave now, we should get to Tangrene just about on time for the big battle.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]]|<ref name="TLC5">[[The Last Command 5|''The Last Command'' 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Dona Laza system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a [[Unidentified planet (Dona Laza)|planet]] that hosted the [[Dona Laza]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] and the [[Mumbri Storve]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="TLC" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> The Dona Laza system was located at a distance of approximately twenty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel away from the [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]].<ref name="TLC5" />
